facts.fact: The regulator PURA, with WARDIP and the Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy, held a validation workshop at the African Princess Hotel where telecom executives, consultants and development partners reviewed its proposed regulatory tools (cost modelling, tariff benchmarking, pricing frameworks) for ex-ante telecom regulation, and PURA's director general called on stakeholders to contribute before it finalised the framework.
facts.system: Regulatory Tools for Ex-Ante Regulation on the Wholesale and Retail Telecommunications Services and Products
